title: ARSIA DPoP Proof JWT Payload
description: Schema for the decoded payload of a DPoP proof JWT per ARSIA-Core.md §6.3 and RFC 9449 §4. The header schema is in $defs/dpop-header.

allOf.description: Unique identifier for this DPoP proof (UUID v4). MUST NOT be reused (replay protection). ARSIA-Core.md §6.3.

htm.description: HTTP method of the request. ARSIA requires POST for all inbox deliveries. ARSIA-Core.md §6.3, §8.1.

htu.description: HTTP URI of the target inbox endpoint. MUST match the request URL. ARSIA-Core.md §6.3.

iat.description: Issued-at time as NumericDate. MUST be within ±300 seconds of the receiver's clock. ARSIA-Core.md §6.3.

ath.description: Base64url-encoded SHA-256 hash of the access token. Binds the DPoP proof to a specific access token. ARSIA-Core.md §6.3, RFC 9449 §4.2.

dpop-header.title: ARSIA DPoP Proof JWT Header
dpop-header.description: JOSE header for ARSIA DPoP proof JWTs. ARSIA-Core.md §6.3.

typ.description: Token type. MUST be 'dpop+jwt' per RFC 9449 §4.2.

alg.description: Signing algorithm. ARSIA requires EdDSA (Ed25519). ARSIA-Core.md §5.1, §6.3.

jwk.description: The public key (JWK) corresponding to the signing key. Its thumbprint MUST match the cnf.jkt in the access token.
